entry.value: -- TRANSACTION START%%00010BEGIN;%%00010%%00010-- 1. UPSERT PROJECTS%%00010-- "Upsert": If RCN exists, Update it. If not, Insert it.%%00010INSERT INTO public.cordis_projects (%%00010 rcn, acronym, title, start_date, end_date, %%00010 total_cost, ec_max_contribution, objective, last_updated%%00010)%%00010SELECT %%00010 rcn, acronym, title, start_date, end_date, %%00010 total_cost, ec_max_contribution, objective, NOW()%%00010FROM public.staging_projects%%00010ON CONFLICT (rcn) %%00010DO UPDATE SET%%00010 acronym = EXCLUDED.acronym,%%00010 title = EXCLUDED.title,%%00010 start_date = EXCLUDED.start_date,%%00010 end_date = EXCLUDED.end_date,%%00010 total_cost = EXCLUDED.total_cost,%%00010 ec_max_contribution = EXCLUDED.ec_max_contribution,%%00010 objective = EXCLUDED.objective,%%00010 last_updated = NOW();%%00010%%00010-- 2. REFRESH PARTICIPANTS%%00010-- Strategy: Delete old participants for these specific projects, then insert the new ones.%%00010-- This handles cases where a partner left or joined the project.%%00010%%00010-- A. Remove old participants for the projects currently in staging%%00010DELETE FROM public.cordis_participants%%00010WHERE project_rcn IN (SELECT DISTINCT rcn FROM public.staging_projects);%%00010%%00010-- B. Insert fresh participants from staging%%00010INSERT INTO public.cordis_participants (%%00010 project_rcn, org_id, legal_name, country_code, role, ec_contribution%%00010)%%00010SELECT %%00010 project_rcn, org_id, legal_name, country_code, role, ec_contribution%%00010FROM public.staging_participants;%%00010%%00010-- TRANSACTION END%%00010COMMIT;
